body.name: \(b^{\star}\)
body.def: \(b^{\star}_{j,u}(x)=\frac13+\sum_{m\in\operatorname{pred}(j)}c^{\star}_{jm}(\mathbf1\{x=u_m\}-\frac13)\), where \(\operatorname{pred}(j)\) is the set of parents preceding the diagonal parent in the selected triangular order
body.role: context-specific base columns of the witness matrices
